Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players have made their way out in the middle. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan walk out with their blades. Tim Southee will begin with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Pakistan have done exceptionally well towards the end and will be confident of chasing this par total down. The Kiwis do have a quality bowling attack and are truly capable of defending this one down. However, they will have to be at their best. Let's see how the second innings pans out. Stay tuned!

Glenn Phillips is down for a chat. He says that the score they got is roughly around par and says that 190 would have been a good score and they probably are some runs short. Tells that Pakistan bowlers bowled well in the end and mixed their pace quite well and adds that they need to do the job with the ball. Mentions that it was nice to get a partnership in the middle with Kane but feels that they lost wickets at the wrong time. Adds that they try to make the final as intense as possible and it’s a great way to build up towards the World Cup. Mentions that they need to bowl well with the new ball and then use their variations at the death.

The Kiwis will be disappointed with how things have ended for them, considering the fiery start they got. They began well with Finn Allen displaying his array of shots in the first over itself. However, his stay at the crease was very short as he was dismissed in the first 6 balls of the match. Kane Williamson and Glenn Phillips put on a stand of 50 runs and put the Kiwis in the driving seat as they were cruising at 83 for 2 at the halfway stage. The latter perished after a positive start, while Kane Williamson was dismissed after notching up his half-ton. Mark Chapman and James Neesham did play some lusty blows but failed to go till the end. They were well on course to set a target of over 180, but some great death bowling by Pakistan restricted them to under 165.

End of an entertaining first half of the game and it will be Pakistan who will go into this break as the happier side! It's been a great recovery from the Men in Green as they have restricted the Kiwis to below 170. They got off to a shaky start. They did manage to grab two wickets in the Powerplay but leaked too many runs. They were not consistent with their bowling but did well in patches and broke crucial stands. However, they have done a tremendous job in the slog-overs. Their pacers did not give away any freebies and did not let New Zealand get away with a big total.

Another bye to end the innings! Michael Bracewell sets himself up to scoop this delivery and Rauf cleverly shortens his length. Michael Bracewell ends up missing this delivery and the batters sneak another bye as Rizwan misses his shy at the batter's end again. New Zealand finish with 163/7 at the end of 20 overs!
Back of a length and outside off. Southee looks to pull it but misses. The batters sneak a bye as Rizwan misses the stumps this time.
Tim Southee walks out to bat on his 100th T20I.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is exceptional death bowling by Rauf! Simply brilliant. Rauf now bowls a quick short ball, around off. Sodhi tries to pull it but is hurried by the pace and ends up getting the top edge. The ball goes in the air towards right of Rizwan and he takes a fine catch keeping his eyes on the ball till the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: A slower short ball outside off. Michael Bracewell dabs it towards covers for a single.
Yorker again on off. Michael Bracewell manages to get his bat down in time.
A yorker on middle. Sodhi digs it out towards the leg side and goes for a single. Rauf runs across to his right and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Sodhi was a goner there!
Nails a yorker on off. Sodhi somehow manages to dig it out and takes a single.
Ish Sodhi makes his way out in the middle.

OUT! RUN OUT! Good work from Rizwan behind the stumps and James Neesham who was looking so dangerous has to walk back. This is a lovely slower delivery. Back of a length and around off. Michael Bracewell tries to play it towards the leg side but gets beaten by the lack of pace. The ball goes off the bounce to the keeper and James Neesham tries to steal a bye. Rizwan though is aware and fires an under-arm throw at the batter's end. James Neesham is short of his crease as the replays confirm it and Pakistan have got a bonus wicket here.
Michael Bracewell comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mark Chapman departs and Naseem Shah gets his second wicket. Shah with that slower shortish delivery again outside off. Mark Chapman tries to slap it away but only manages to get the bottom of his blade. The ball goes aerially and straight to long off and Babar Azam there takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Naseem Shah

Commentary.Commentary: A yorker on off. James Neesham drills it to long on for a single.
Another slower short ball and outside off. James Neesham tries to hit it towards the leg side again but misses.
SIX! That's James Neesham at his best! A slower short ball, on off. In the slot for Neesham and he pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Naseem Shah comes to bowl the penultimate over.
Good end to the over for Pakistan but 11 from it! A slower length ball, outside off. Chapman tries to pull it but misses.
FOUR! Good shot! Gets his scoop shot right this time. A low full toss on off. Chapman moves across to his left and scoops it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Mark Chapman tries to get under it but misses.
Just a single! Bowls it full and on middle. James Neesham drills it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Quality shot! Bowls it fuller and on off. James Neesham makes room and smashes it through the extra-cover region for a boundary.
A yorker on off. James Neesham makes room and steers it towards deep backward point for a couple.
Mohammad Wasim comes to bowl his final over.
Dot to end! A low full toss, outside off. Chapman makes room and tries to drive it but misses.
Back of a length again angling into middle. James Neesham tries to pull it but misses and gets hit high on the pads. The ball deflects towards the off side and a leg bye is taken.
Good running! Very full and outside off. James Neesham slices it to deep point for a couple.
On the shorter side, on off. Chapman punches it to cover for a single.
Back of a length, on middle from 'round the wicket at 147 clicks. James Neesham tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length and around off. Chapman pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Haris Rauf comes back on! 1 for 15 in his 2 overs.
Tossed up on middle. James Neesham reverse-sweeps it to short third man.
James Neesham comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kane Williamson holes out in the deep and Shadab Khan provides an important breakthrough! Clever from Shadab Khan, he tosses this up but outside off. Kane Williamson fetches it from outside off and goes for a slog-sweep. He, however, does not get enough power behind this shot and ends up hitting it right of long on. Shan Masood there runs to his right and takes a good sliding catch. End of a good knock from the Kiwi skipper.
Commentary.Howout: c Shan Masood b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls it fuller and on leg. Kane Williamson paddles it to short fine leg.
On middle and fuller. Mark Chapman clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Kane Williamson sets himself up for a reverse-sweep and Khan very cleverly bowls it down the leg side. In the end, Kane plays a square drive as a left-hander to cover-point for a single.
On the shorter side, on off. Kane Williamson punches it to covers for a couple.
Shadab Khan is back on.
A length ball, around the off pole. Kane Williamson backs away and looks to cut this one away. But the ball goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg for a single.

SIX! Oh, shot! Kane Williamson brings up his fifty in style! A short ball, around middle. Kane Williamson makes room and slaps it just over the leaping fielder at deep point. It's been a lovely knock from the skipper, so far!
A slower ball, the length is full now, around middle and leg. Mark Chapman flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Mohammad Wasim errs in line here! He serves it down the leg side, on a length, slower ball as well. Mark Chapman goes for the pull shot but the ball goes off his glove away from the keeper and towards fine leg for a boundary.
Another shortish ball, around the leg pole. Kane Williamson puls it firmly but finds the fielder at deep square leg. Another run!
Mohammad Wasim begins his second spell with a slower one, around middle and leg. Mark Chapman works it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Mohammad Wasim is back on. Two overs for 12 runs so far.
Mohammad Nawaz serves it full now, around middle. Kane Williamson sweeps it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Back of a length now, around middle. Mark Chapman miscues his reverse-sweeps towards short fine leg for a single.
SIX! BANG! Top shot! A fuller ball, tossed up as well, around middle. Mark Chapman steps down, makes room and goes inside-out over extra cover for a biggie!

DROPPED! Another chance goes begging! Babar Azam the culprit here now. A short ball, outside off. Kane Williamson stays in his crease and pushes it towards cover. Babar Azam jumps, gets both his hands to the ball but fails to hold on it. A single now.
A fuller one, quicker, around middle. Mark Chapman reverse-sweeps it through point for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Kane Williamson goes back in his crease and pulls it down to long on for a single.

Close! A better throw and Mark Chapman would have been on his way back! A length ball, around the thigh pad. Mark Chapman tucks it towards square leg and leaves his crease. They come back for the second run as well. However, the throw from Haider Ali was well away from the stumps. Mohammad Rizwan too could not grab it. Two taken in the end!
Another slower one, down the leg side now. Kane Williamson pulls it gently towards short fine leg for a single.
Well bowled! Naseem Shah takes the pace off this one and serves a short ball, around middle. Kane Williamson backs away from that one and lets it go. He had no idea how to play that one.
Outside off now, on a length. Kane Williamson blocks it out from the inner half of the bat towards the bowler.
Two now! This is excellent running! A length ball, angling in, around middle. Kane Williamson pushes it towards the vacant mid-wicket region for two runs.
A length delivery, around the off pole. Mark Chapman hops and dabs it towards backward point for a single.
Naseem Shah is back into the attack. He has been expensive in the first two overs but has also taken an important wicket of Finn Allen.
A fullish delivery now, around middle and leg. Mark Chapman knocks it down to long on for a single.
Back of a length again, around middle. Mark Chapman pushes it back to the bowler.
Shortish ball, around middle. Mark Chapman tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Mark Chapman walks out at number 5!

OUT! TAKEN! Mohammad Nawaz strikes and gets rid of the dangerous, Glenn Phillips! A key wicket and at a crucial time for Pakistan. Mohammad Nawaz tosses it up, serves it full, around middle and leg. Glenn Phillips looks to go over long on. But he fails to get the desired elevation and distance on that one. Shan Masood there takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shan Masood b Mohammad Nawaz

Commentary.Commentary: A shorter one, around middle. Kane Williamson looks to pull this one but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
SIX! Up and away! Good start ti the over for New Zealand! A loopy one, fuller ball, around off. Kane Williamson shimmies down the pitch and smokes it straight down the ground for a biggie!
Slightly short now, around middle and leg. Kane Williamson rocks back and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, full this time, around middle and leg. Glenn Phillips flicks it wide of long on for a single.
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Kane Williamson pushes it through cover off the back foot now. One run is taken!
Two this time! Full in length, around middle. Kane Williamson clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Quicker, around middle and leg. Glenn Phillips rocks back and works it away towards square leg. Another single!
Tossed up, full, around middle. Kane Williamson steps down the pitch and strokes it down to long on for a single.

DRINKS! New Zealand have their noses slightly ahead in this innings at the halfway stage! Kane Williamson and Glenn Phillips are rotating the strike well and putting away bad balls. They might be aiming for something over 170 here, probably more if Glenn Phillips sticks around till the end. Pakistan will just aim to grab quick wickets and restrict New Zealand for a par total.
Fires it on off, touch shorter. Kane Williamson punches it to sweeper cover for a single. 8 from the over.
Shorter in length and outside off. Glenn Phillips cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter delivery and bit quicker. Glenn Phillips blocks it off the front foot.
A fuller one on middle. Kane Williamson makes some room and drives it to long off for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Glenn Phillips drives it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Glenn Phillips seems to be in great touch here. Fraction short on off. Glenn Phillips rocks back and pulls it in the gap towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Tossed up on off. Glenn Phillips sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Keeps it fuller on middle. Glenn Phillips plays it right of the bowler but Khan stops it.
Pushed quicker and flatter on off. Glenn Phillips cuts it to sweeper cover for a couple.
SIX! Wow! That's a quality shot! This is bit slower through the air and full outside off. Glenn Phillips plays a lofted cover drive that sails over the fence.
Bit wider outside off and fuller. Glenn Phillips opens the face of his blade as he drives it. Takes two as the fielder in the sweeper cover cuts it off.
Bowls it full and around off. Kane Williamson drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Just a single again, tidy stuff from Nawaz. Bowls it fuller and on middle. Kane Williamson knocks it down to long on for a single.
Single again! A fuller one on off. Glenn Phillips eases it to down to long on for a single.
Kane Williamson shimmies down the track and converts this delivery into a full toss that is angled into middle. Takes a single to deep mid-wicket as he clips it.
Tad shorter on off. Glenn Phillips punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Another flatter delivery, on off. Glenn Phillips pushes it to covers.
Fires it on middle and Kane Williamson just nudges it to mid-wicket. He initially looks for the second run but the pair decides against it. Just a single.
Mohammad Nawaz comes in to bowl.
This is pushed bit quicker on middle. Kane Williamson reaches the pitch of the ball and knocks it to long on for a single.
Loopy delivery again on off. Glenn Phillips with a drive to long off for a single.
Lovely bowling, bowls it fuller and on off. Kane Williamson eases it to covers for another single.
Tad shorter again on off. Glenn Phillips punches it to deep cover for another single.
Shorter in length and outside off. Glenn Phillips cuts it towards left of the sweeper cover and gets two.
Tossed up, on off. Kane Williamson drives it to long off for a single.
Shadab Khan is brought into the attack!
On a length, on middle. Glenn Phillips works it through mid-wicket for a couple. 5 from the over and a wicket. At the end of the Powerplay, New Zealand are 51/2!
Serves it on a length, on off at 145.9 kph. Glenn Phillips defends it off the middle of his blade this time.
Breaks the bottom of his blade this time! Hits the hard length, around off. Glenn Phillips tries to defend it as the ball hits the bottom of his bat at 143 clicks.
Serves it short of good length and outside off. Glenn Phillips punches it past point for a couple. He is off the mark.
Glenn Phillips walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! BOWLED! Haris Rauf strikes and the prolific Devon Conway departs early today. He was struggling to get going and chops this onto his stumps. Back of a length and around off. Conway makes room and tries to cut it but gets the inside edge that shatters the stumps. Pakistan have two wickets in the Powerplay and this will be a nice little test for the New Zealand middle order.
Starts his second over with a back-of-a-length delivery angling into the body. Kane Williamson clips it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Haris Rauf is back on.
A dot to end then! Width on offer now, a length ball. Devon Conway looks to cut this one away but he fails to get any connection on that.
Two more now! A touch slow now, on the pads, a length ball. Devon Conway clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Down the leg side, a shortish ball. Devon Conway pulls it towards the left of the fielder at deep square leg. Two taken!
Swing and a miss now! Outside off, back of a length, Devon Conway advances down the pitch and looks to pull this one. But he fails to get any bat on it.
On a length now, outside off. Devon Conway drives this one firmly but finds the fielder at mid off.
Slighty short now, around middle. Devon Conway swivels and goes for the pull shot. But he misses and gets hit near his groin area.
Naseem Shah ends his over with a length ball, outside off. Devon Conway opens the face of his bat and guides it towards backward point for a single. He retains the strike!
On a length, outside off again. Kane Williamson drives this one on the up and through the diving fielder at cover-point. The ball will not race away but the batters get three.
Asif Ali is standing alongside  the boundary line and looks ready to get back on the field.
Around middle, a good-length delivery. Kane Williamson blocks it out.
Beaten now! Outside off this time, a length ball. Kane Williamson looks to push this one away but fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Naseem Shah spills this one on the pads, on a length. Kane Williamson just tickles it fine and towards fine leg for another boundary. Two in two for Kane Williamson!
FOUR! Oh, lovely shot! Fuller ball, outside off. Kane Williamson leans in and creams his drive through cover for a boundary.

Play and a miss! Mohammad Wasim pulls his length back now, he serves it around off. Devon Conway steps down the pitch and looks to have a poke at this one. But he misses and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Outside off, a good-length delivery. Devon Conway pushes this one towards cover.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tailing in a tad, around the off pole, on a length. Devon Conway shuffles across, closes the face of the bat and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Angling in, around middle and leg, a length ball. Devon Conway blocks it out from the inner half of his blade.
Another length delivery, around off. Devon Conway pushes it towards mid off. Dot now!

Asif Ali seems to have hurt himself as he tries to dive to stop that boundary. The physio is on the field and after some treatment and consultation, Asif Ali is walking off the field. It does not look too serious though and we might see him back on the field soon.

FOUR! Devon Conway bags his first boundary now! On a length, outside off. Devon Conway drives it past cover-point. Asif Ali chases the ball but no avail. Although he seems to have hurt his knee while trying to stop the ball with a dive.
So just one over for Naseem Shah. Mohammad Wasim is into the attack now.
Tad fuller, the line is outside off now. Kane Williamson drives it but finds the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for the Kiwi skipper! This one angles in, a fuller ball, around middle and leg. Kane Williamson flicks it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Kane Williamson is off the mark in fine fashion! Outside off, a good-length delivery. Kane Williamson drives it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Pitched up, outside off. Devon Conway leans in and drives it towards mid off for a single. He gets off the mark with that!
Well bowled! Very full, around middle. Devon Conway digs it out back to the bowler.
Wide! Sprays this one down the leg side, a length ball. Devon Conway leaves it alone. Wide called.
Haris Rauf starts off with a length ball, outside off. Devon Conway knocks it towards cover off the back foot.
Kane Williamson walks out at number 3! Also, Haris Rauf will share the new ball with Naseem Shah.

OUT! TAKEN! Naseem Shah has the last laugh here! He gets his man and draws first blood for Pakistan. Excellent comeback from him. He is pumped! Slightly shorter, outside off. Finn Allen stays in his crease and looks to punch it through cover. But the ball goes off the toe-end towards the fielder at cover. Mohammad Nawaz pouches it safely. An eventful first over from Naseem Shah comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Naseem Shah

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Finn Allen is taking charge in the first over itself! Naseem Shah serves it full now, the line is outside off again, Finn Allen shimmies down the pitch and drives it through cover for the third boundary already!
FOUR! Up and over! Lovely from Finn Allen! A length ball, outside off. Finn Allen dances down the pitch and lifts it over mid off for another boundary in the over.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Finn Allen dabs it off the back foot towards cover. A dot now!
FOUR! Finn Allen and New Zealand are underway in style! Naseem Shah drops it slightly short now, around middle. Finn Allen advances down the pitch and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Naseem Shah begins with a length ball, outside off, angling away, at around 142 clicks. Finn Allen pushes it towards cover off the back foot.

The conditions are perfect for cricket as the sun is shining bright and we now have Pakistan team in the huddle. They disperse to take their respective positions as Devon Conway and Finn Allen walk out to open the innings. Naseem Shah is ready to start with the new ball. Here we go....

Time for the national anthems. It will be Pakistan's first followed by the New Zealand one. Games like this are critical when you are building towards the World Cup where one gets to see who can step up in a big game under comparitively more pressure.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Devon Conway (WK), Finn Allen, Kane Williamson (C) (In for Martin Guptill), Glenn Phillips, Mark Chapman, James Neesham, Michael Bracewell, Ish Sodhi, Tim Southee, Trent Boult, Blair Tickner (In for Adam Milne).

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Shan Masood, Iftikhar Ahmed, Shadab Khan, Haider Ali, Asif Ali, Mohammad Nawaz, Mohammad Wasim, Naseem Shah, Haris Rauf (In for Mohammad Hasnain).
TOSS - Pakistan have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

Pakistan, on the other hand, need their middle order to fire. A quality team like New Zealand would have their plans ready for the opening pair and Pakistan need someone to step up if both Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam fail to make an impact. Mohammad Nawaz and Shadab Khan, the two spin-bowling all-rounders are also integral to the success of this Pakistan team and let’s see how Pakistan responds in this game after getting beaten comprehensively in the last encounter between these two sides. A series win here will be a big boost for both sides ahead of the marquee event and let’s hope for a cracking finale. Stay tuned for the toss and further updates.
